name: track_onboarding_visit
description: Records that a user reached a stage of the /signup-flow onboarding.

input.name: flow
input.description:
"child" or "parent". May be omitted: after the Stripe round-trip the page
reloads and the browser no longer knows which flow it was in, so the flow
is resolved from this session's earlier rows instead.

input.name: step
input.description: Stage key from STEPS in signup-flow/lib.js, e.g. "names".

input.name: step_index
input.description: Zero-based position of the stage within STEPS.
